Price opened BELOW value. Panic or opportunity? 📉➡️📈

The open tells you which game the market is playing. Below yesterday's value area low (VAL), most traders panic and sell the hole. I watch for one thing: price coming back to the VAL. A big buyer right at the VAL plus CVD turning up = buyers are taking value back. Once price is inside value again, the natural target is the POC, where the most volume traded.

1️⃣ Open below the VAL = wait, don't chase the move
2️⃣ Retest of the VAL + big buyer + CVD turning up = entry
3️⃣ Back inside value = target the POC

Episode 2 of "The OPEN decides the trade". Save this and FOLLOW @institutionalmetatrading for the other two setups: open INSIDE and open ABOVE value 🔔
